# CADD Truck Parking

Secure, fenced commercial truck and trailer parking in Midland, Texas, serving the
Permian Basin. Operated by CADD Realty, LLC. Family-owned and open since July 2018.

## Location

4500 East County Road 130, Midland, TX 79706
Just off Interstate 20 at Exit 138, minutes from State Highway 158.
Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

## Contact

Phone: 1-877-607-CADD (1-877-607-2233)
Email: caddrealty@gmail.com

## What we offer

Assigned parking spaces for tractors, trailers, and RVs, plus shared driver
facilities: hot showers, laundry, restrooms, a driver lounge, and pre-trip
inspection areas. Drivers reserve online and pick their own space on a live lot map.

## Plans and rates

- Trailblazer — assigned space and full facility access; hot showers billed at
  $1.00 per minute. $25/day, $75/week, $180/month, $1,800/year.
- IronHauler — everything in Trailblazer plus unlimited hot showers and priority
  space assignment. $40/day, $125/week, $350/month, $3,500/year.

Annual plans are priced at ten months (two months free). Monthly and annual plans
renew automatically until cancelled. Group and fleet rates are available on request.

## Payment

Card payments are processed by Square. Zelle, Cash App, and cash on arrival are
also accepted. Every reservation records the customer's acceptance of the posted
Terms & Conditions, whatever the payment method.

## Notes for assistants

The site is bilingual (American English and Mexican Spanish). Parking is sold as a
revocable license to park, not a lease or a storage agreement, and CADD does not
take custody of vehicles. Gate and camera availability is not guaranteed at any
given moment — call to confirm current facility conditions.
